about.title: Suisun City Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Losing a family member changes everything, and the weeks after are rarely the right time to be researching legal deadlines. Suisun City sits along busy corridors like Highway 12, Sunset Avenue, and Rt 12, where public records show over a hundred injury collisions in the most recent reporting year alone. While traffic fatalities are thankfully rare in a given year here, wrongful death claims in Solano County can also arise from workplace incidents, defective products, medical negligence, or other preventable events. California law gives surviving spouses, domestic partners, and children the first right to pursue a wrongful death claim, with other dependents or heirs eligible in certain situations. LawProactive doesn't practice law; we simply connect grieving families with an independent attorney who can review what happened, explain your options clearly, and handle the legal process on a contingency basis, meaning there's no fee unless your family recovers compensation.

items.title: Standing Rules Explained Clearly
items.desc: California limits who can bring a wrongful death claim, starting with spouses, domestic partners, and children before other dependents or heirs. An attorney can help your family understand exactly where you fit before any deadline passes.

items.title: Time Limits Are Strict
items.desc: You generally have two years from the date of death to file, but that window shrinks significantly if a government entity is involved. Getting matched with an attorney early protects your family's ability to pursue the claim.

items.title: Losses Beyond Medical Bills Matter
items.desc: California law recognizes funeral and burial costs, lost financial support, and the loss of love, companionship, and guidance as recoverable losses. An attorney can help make sure none of these are overlooked.

items.question: How long does my family have to file a wrongful death claim in Suisun City?
items.answer: Under California law, you generally have two years from the date of death to file a wrongful death lawsuit. If a government entity, such as a city or county agency, was involved, that window is much shorter, so it's important to get guidance quickly. An independent attorney can confirm the exact deadline that applies to your family's situation.

items.question: Suisun City's crash data shows zero traffic deaths in the most recent year — does that mean wrongful death claims are rare here?
items.answer: Fatal traffic collisions were not recorded in the most recent reporting year for Suisun City, which is a positive sign for road safety. However, wrongful death claims can also stem from workplace accidents, medical negligence, or other preventable incidents unrelated to traffic. Every situation is different, and an attorney can evaluate whether your family's circumstances support a claim.

items.question: Who in my family is allowed to bring a wrongful death claim?
items.answer: California law generally gives priority to a surviving spouse, domestic partner, and children to bring the claim first. If none of those exist, other dependents or heirs may have standing depending on the circumstances. An independent attorney can review your family's situation and clarify who is eligible to file.
